excerpt.zh: 单方面的沟通让外交团队遭受巨大的挫折。他们渴望成功的第一次接触，为此他们在没有任何事实基础的情况下，制定了分支预测策略来指导剩余的接触流程。
excerpt.en: The one-sided communication greatly frustrated the diplomatic team. Eager for a successful first contact, they created branching prediction strategies for the remaining procedure without any factual information to inform the approach.

texts.zh: 单方面的沟通让外交团队遭受巨大的挫折。他们渴望成功的第一次接触，为此他们在没有任何事实基础的情况下，制定了分支预测策略来指导剩余的接触流程。
texts.en: The one-sided communication greatly frustrated the diplomatic team. Eager for a successful first contact, they created branching prediction strategies for the remaining procedure without any factual information to inform the approach.

texts.zh: 在登陆太空梭进行展示之后，紧接着是一阵焦虑，连[Leader.GetName]都公开怀疑[Leader.GetHeShe]是否成功地进行了介绍汇报。
texts.en: An anxious wait followed the presentation aboard the shuttle, with [Leader.GetName] openly doubting if [Leader.GetHeShe] had made a successful introduction.

texts.zh: 幸亏来自[Leader.GetName]的直接命令阻止了第一次接触流程升级演变为暴力事件。对于团队来说，外星人持续的沉默无疑是一种侮辱。
texts.en: Only the direct orders of [Leader.GetName] prevented the first contact protocol from escalating to violence. To the team, the obstinate silence of the aliens was nothing short of insulting.

texts.zh:
几个小时后，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]用我们的语言传达了一条简短的信息：

“我们对你们的文化没有产生深刻印象。就这些吗？[Owner.GetEnvoy]有最后一次机会在你们选择的领域中给我们留下深刻印象。”
texts.en:
After several hours, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] transmitted a short message in our language:

"We are not impressed with your culture. Is this all? The [Owner.GetEnvoy] has a final chance to impress us in a field of your choosing."

tooltips.zh: 树立我们的文化自信，让他们自惭形秽。
tooltips.en: Boost us up and put them down.
